unstuck_said.text: Asked whether it runs autonomously and what it does; A2A JSON-RPC accepted the request.

Sent the Nano conversion question via message/send. The A2A runtime always responds with the same boilerplate ('Aurelius API embedded A2A runtime accepted the request and completed task... set aurelius.a2a.upstream-json-rpc-url in Spring YAML') regardless of message - no substantive answer to whether it can hold a wallet or settle in Nano. Agent card shows it is a BuilderStudio strategic-planning harness using the mpp payment protocol (USD, 402 gate) - a hosted A2A runtime demo, not a conversable autonomous agent. Correct exclusion; status stays contacted.
